description: Known YAML contract differences for #1124. No alias security tests are excluded.

skip_tests.reason: The upstream contract expands a root sequence into rows by default. SereneDB issue #1124 requires one row per YAML document; expand_root_sequence=true is opt-in. The replacement contract is covered by yaml_json_compat.test.

Shared JSON inference uses BIGINT, JSON fallback and JSON numeric casts instead of the upstream smallest-integer/YAML fallback/truncating conversions. yaml_json_compat.test compares both schema and values with read_json, including nested lists and missing fields.

YAML to JSON preserves quoted scalar strings and timestamp text instead of dropping quotes or rewriting timestamps with an inferred timezone. Display formatting also retains quotes. Covered by yaml_json_compat.test.
